changes.text: Oct 25 combined gate was unmet. Late Oct 26 controlled Moto proof records Fernlands starter/shop/Iguanodon hatch/work and OS kill/relaunch. Today’s native/capacity gates remain pending. Fourteen days to freeze require 15.0 total and 9.5 first packages/week; capacity is unproven.

New approved all-island shop-band hatch curve and per-island daily personal starts are source committed. The study excludes the new hatch curve; final profiles, model/gameplay proof and native gates remain open.

Reset parity and fail-closed runner fixed. Workload corrected:10approved looks integrated,11redos+19first packages remain. Approved economy/storage/Fernlands packages implemented;15source/model prices still differ. Oct25 phone and capacity gates remain open.
Historical Oct20 checkpoint: reset-order defect was found and Forest refresh advanced. Later verified repair supersedes that blocker; subsequent decisions approved selected numerical packages.

All 40 now seeded in approved source homes, eight per shop/Book, with five active islands and recorded local loop proof. Native/hosted launch rollout and final balance remain open; 19 still use placeholder art. Selected still baseline approved, Rex reveal committed. Fresh-start decision retires legacy relocation work.

Frozair locked all 40 species and island homes. Casting review closed. Fresh source audit: 21 committed ranch banks, 19 missing; 14/40 obtainable anywhere, 10/40 in intended homes. Para/Kentro are committed; Dilophosaurus has banks. Fernlands phone slice and production benchmark lead the updated plan.

Recommended habitat revision: Iguanodon → greener Fernlands; Nanuqsaurus, Prince Creek Edmontosaurus, Leaellynasaura and Woolly Rhinoceros proposed for Snow. Borealopelta, Cryolophosaurus, Citipati and Concavenator benched in this proposal. Eight per island/40 total and all milestone dates stay; no game data changes.
